title: Rust 1.99.1 stable release
note: Official release record checked for compiler, library and linker fixes. Release freshness is not a performance claim; pin the exact toolchain and rerun target tests before adoption.

title: SQLite 3.54.1 release history and patch correction
note: Official news states 3.54.1 fixes a heap-buffer overflow affecting some 32-bit builds in 3.54.0; 64-bit builds are not affected by that specific issue. Do not benchmark or recommend 3.54.0 as the final 3.54 baseline.

title: SQLite 3.54.0 query planner and platform changes
note: Official release notes describe expression-index update avoidance, UNION LIMIT 1 memory/time improvements, O_TMPFILE use and Windows SRWL mutex changes. The reported speedtest1 cycle improvement is workload/build-specific, not a prediction for Atlas workloads.

title: WebTransport API browser support and transport model
observed_version: Baseline 2026; broad latest-browser availability from March 2026
note: Reviewed secure-context requirement, worker availability, HTTP/3 transport, multiple reliable streams and unreliable datagrams. Compatibility still varies; treat as an optional transport with an explicit WebSocket or other fallback.

title: Hugging Face WebGPU kernels and Fleet evidence workflow
note: Official article describes versioned WGSL packages with interfaces, correctness cases, benchmark cases and a consent-based cross-device Fleet evidence workflow. Community/device results are external observations, not Atlas measurements; validate numerical tolerances and end-to-end browser behavior locally.

title: OWASP GenAI and Agentic AI exploit roundup Q2 2026
note: OWASP distinguishes observed incidents, research disclosures and controlled validations. Cross-case findings include untrusted collaboration/web content influencing privileged actions and delegated credentials determining blast radius; validate authorization outside the model and audit tool identity, input provenance and destination.

title: OWASP GenAI and Agentic AI exploit roundup Q3 2026
note: Newer quarter follow-up. Selected incidents and disclosures include connected components of an AI-service campaign, three Anthropic incidents and a research-demonstrated Copilot exploit family. Cases are not seven independent attacks; roundup is not exhaustive and explicitly distinguishes occurrence from disclosure dates.
